title: Restore reviewed first-party MCP to retained machine state
problem: Existing official MCP stdio is frozen by blanket child refusal and points at a nested store instead of the integrated machine.
baseline: PR147 guarded packaging and receipt-bound private pages; arbitrary providers remain refused.

roles.position: Only the exact first-party module maps to a fixed child mode; reject unknown providers and env keys; no credentials or arbitrary source. One agent applying distinct perspectives, not independent reviews.
material_concerns: Provider/module/env substitution could authorize unreviewed code.

roles.position: Use exactly the parent-installed canonical staged store in gateway and guard; validate scope on both ends. One agent applying distinct perspectives, not independent reviews.
material_concerns: Nested or widened stores could break machine integration.

roles.position: Expose QUERY_OPS only, test attempted production refusal, and discard the full query stage. One agent applying distinct perspectives, not independent reviews.
material_concerns: Read-only calls could reach write operations or retain query writes.

roles.position: Retain inherited seccomp, per-process limits,30-second group wall budget and group termination; anonymous socketpair only supports asyncio. One agent applying distinct perspectives, not independent reviews.
material_concerns: Descendants could survive revocation or acquire network access.

roles.position: Keep system28 PARTIAL, preserve general-provider/remote requirements and continue the next unblocked dependency. One agent applying distinct perspectives, not independent reviews.
material_concerns: Scoped proof could redefine the full provider horizon.

Descendants outlive STOP or network filter is weakened.
